working_directory.description: Working directory for zone files, transfer files, and other runtime data.

port.description: Main DNS port to listen on (typically 53 for both TCP and UDP).

listen_on.description: List of IPv4 addresses (and optional ports) to bind DNS services to. If empty, defaults to all interfaces.

listen_on_v6.description: List of IPv6 addresses to bind DNS services to. If empty, disables IPv6 listening.

allow_query.description: List of IP addresses, networks (CIDR), or named ACLs allowed to query this server.

allow_recursion.description: List of networks permitted to perform recursive queries. If empty, defaults to 'localhost' and 'localnets'.

dnssec_validation.description: Enable DNSSEC validation: 'auto', 'yes', 'no', or 'strict'. Use 'auto' for recommended behavior.

forwarders.description: List of upstream DNS servers to forward unresolved queries to.

forward_policy.description: Forwarding behavior: 'first' (try forwarders, then recursive), 'only' (only forward), or 'none'.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum cache size in megabytes (MB) for the answer cache. Set to 0 for unlimited (not recommended).

querylog.description: Enable query logging (to syslog). Useful for troubleshooting; disable in production unless needed.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used to track the running daemon process.

stats_file.description: Path to the statistics output file (used by 'rndc stats').

doh_endpoint.description: Configure DNS over HTTPS (DoH). Requires BIND 9.16+ and TLS certificates.
